explication: yabai is a macOS tiling window manager. A user issues commands through its CLI to manage windows, spaces, and displays; the core product also automatically tiles windows using binary space partitioning. The tree identifies the relevant runtime modules, while the README documents the capabilities. The supplied source index reports no imports or named repository-file references for the indexed files, so internal call paths are not established here; dashed, uncited links mark likely but unverified coordination. The documented scripting-addition integration is shown separately.
